observations.probe:
"""Build a one-extent sparse pax entry and test extraction to append and ordinary fds."""
from hashlib import sha256
from pathlib import Path
import json
import os
import subprocess
import sys
import tarfile

binary = Path(sys.argv[1]).resolve()
out = Path(os.environ["TMPDIR"])
payload = b"D" * 4096
source = out / "sparse.bin"
with source.open("wb") as stream:
    stream.seek(4096)
    stream.write(payload)
archive = out / "sparse.pax"
subprocess.run(["tar","--format=pax","--sparse","--sparse-version=1.0","-cf",archive,"-C",out,source.name],check=True)
with tarfile.open(archive) as tar:
    member = tar.getmember(source.name)
    assert member.size == 8192 and [(o,n) for o,n in member.sparse if n] == [(4096,4096)]
    assert tar.extractfile(member).read() == bytes(4096) + payload
observed = {}
for mode in ("append", "ordinary"):
    path = out / (mode + ".out")
    prefix = b"PREFIX!" if mode == "append" else b""
    path.write_bytes(prefix)
    fd = os.open(path, os.O_WRONLY | (os.O_APPEND if mode == "append" else 0))
    try:
        assert os.lseek(fd, 0, os.SEEK_CUR) == 0
        result = subprocess.run([binary,"-xOf",archive], stdout=fd, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
    finally:
        os.close(fd)
    data = path.read_bytes()
    expected = prefix + bytes(4096) + payload
    observed[mode] = {"exit":result.returncode, "stderr":result.stderr.decode(errors="replace").strip(),
                      "bytes":len(data), "expected_bytes":len(expected),
                      "exact_match":data == expected, "prefix_and_data_without_hole":data == prefix + payload,
                      "sha256":sha256(data).hexdigest(), "expected_sha256":sha256(expected).hexdigest()}
print(json.dumps({"entry_size":member.size,"data_extents":[[4096,4096]],"results":observed}, sort_keys=True))
